component.name: Mithrandir-RS
component.summary: High-performance Linux cleaner, telemetry and AI diagnostics in Rust

description.p: Mithrandir-RS is a native, blazing-fast Linux system maintenance suite and cleaner written in Rust with GTK4 and Libadwaita.

ul.li: High-throughput multi-threaded system cleaning (caches, thumbnails, logs, packages)
Zero-sleep real-time CPU delta, memory, GPU and battery hardware telemetry
In-app Qwen 2.5 and llama.cpp local AI model management
Dual AI Diagnostics supporting Google Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI-compatible providers

description.p: Release v0.4.1 with native Google Gemini AI Studio and Anthropic Claude support.
Initial stable Rust release with GTK4/Libadwaita UI, async telemetry, and local AI manager.
